name: Voice chat
description:
Joins a voice channel and talks: random sentences from Markov chat every few minutes, or whatever /say tells it.
Switch voices with /voice set; when it is not in voice, /say and /speak reply with an audio clip instead.

settings.label: Home voice channel
settings.help: Where OzBot hangs out. /join with no channel also uses this.

settings.label: Join by itself
settings.help: Joins the home channel when a person is in it.

settings.label: Say random sentences
settings.help: Uses Markov chat. Only while people are in the channel.

settings.label: Voice
settings.help: Empty = the default from Voice profiles.

settings.label: Voice for random lines
settings.help: Fixed = the voice above. Random = a different voice from your library for each random line.

settings.label: Allow /say
settings.help: Anyone in the channel can make OzBot say something.

settings.label: Talk without being in voice
settings.help: When OzBot is not in a voice channel, /say and /speak reply with the audio clip instead of refusing.

settings.label: Queue length
settings.help: Sentences waiting to be spoken; extra ones are dropped.
